sloka: तस्य अनुरूपो बलब्वान् रक्ताक्षो दुन्दुभि स्वनः ।कनीयान् लक्ष्मणो भ्राता राका शशि निभ आननः ॥३-३१-१६॥
transliteration: tasya anurūpo balabvān raktākṣo dundubhi svanaḥ ।kanīyān lakṣmaṇo bhrātā rākā śaśi nibha ānanaḥ ॥3-31-16॥

translations.english: He is strong with bright red eyes. He has a deep voice with the resonance of a drum. His face is like the moon. Lakshmana, his younger brother, is similar to him in appearance.
